scenes.text: Imagine standing completely alone as the only tree for over two hundred and fifty miles in every single direction of a burning desert.
For decades, this legendary acacia tree in the Sahara survived against all odds, driving its massive roots over one hundred feet deep into the dry earth just to find a single drop of water.

But in nineteen seventy-three, its miraculous story came to a tragic and almost impossible end when a drunk truck driver somehow managed to crash directly into the only standing obstacle for millions of empty acres.
This historic landmark was instantly knocked to the ground, leaving us to wonder how anyone could be this incredibly unlucky, so tell me in the comments if you think this was truly an accident.
